content: This medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits to you outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare. However, this is not a comprehensive list of possible side effects. If you are in the United States or Canada and experience side effects, contact your doctor for medical advice. Precautions: Before using ketoconazole, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other azole antifungals (such as clotrimazole, econazole, or miconazole), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is unknown if this drug passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use (including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: This medication may be harmful if swallowed. If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Usage Instructions: This medication is prescribed for your current condition only. Do not use it later for another skin condition unless directed by your doctor. If you miss a dose, use it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature. It is flammable, so do not store or use it near an open flame. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individual medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
